text:
Jules Huang: opened a small PR to tidy the audit-export examples and fix a broken internal link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/931
Samir Patel: saw the PR, thx. What's the main change?
Jules Huang: three things: (1) switch examples to use NDJSON for exports (clarify difference from 'bulk JSON'), (2) add a short pseudonymization snippet showing hashed user IDs before export, (3) update an old anchor link that 404s.
Ravi Kapoor: NDJSON makes sense for streaming consumers. Can you add a one-line note about character encoding (utf-8) and newline termination? Some customers stream into S3/Lambda and exact format matters.
Jules Huang: good call. I'll add: "exports are NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON), UTF-8, newline-terminated; each line is a single audit event"
Maria Gomes (Legal): legal note: please avoid language that implies we provide legal-safe pseudonymization. Use 'pseudonymize' and add: "Pseudonymization is a technical measure and does not replace legal advice or compliance assessments."
Jules Huang: added that sentence under the pseudonymization example. Also added two snippets: Python and CLI. Python snippet uses sha256 pseudonymization of user_id before export.
Samir Patel: paste the Python snippet here so we can sanity-check copy-paste:
Jules Huang: ```python
import hashlib
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")

def pseudonymize(id_str):
    return hashlib.sha256(id_str.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

# stream events, pseudonymize user_id, write NDJSON
with client.stream_logs(start_ts=1700000000) as it:
    with open('audit-export.ndjson','w',encoding='utf-8') as out:
        for ev in it:
            ev['user_id'] = pseudonymize(ev.get('user_id',''))
            out.write(json.dumps(ev, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
```
Ravi Kapoor: two nits: (1) import json missing, (2) clarify that the snippet is illustrative and may not scale. Add a comment about batching for large exports.
Jules Huang: fixed imports and added a comment about batching/stream windowing.
docs-bot: build / docs:pr/931: started
Samir Patel: also add a tiny section showing how to request a redacted export from the hosted API (server-side redaction) vs client-side pseudonymization. Customers need to know we offer both.
Jules Huang: added `--redact-sensitive` CLI example and a short paragraph: "Hosted exports can request server-side redaction (recommended for PII-heavy workloads); client-side pseudonymization is shown for customers who want to keep raw K/V but mask IDs before storing."
Maria Gomes (Legal): approved the wording. Add PR description line: "Legal review: 2026-03-21 by M. Gomes" and include the standard disclaimer: "This page is informational and not legal advice."
docs-bot: build / docs:pr/931: succeeded :white_check_mark: staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/security/audit-exports#ndjson
Ravi Kapoor: reviewed and left one tiny formatting suggestion on the NDJSON table (made it clearer).
Samir Patel: merging in 10 unless objections. Also please add a redirect from the old anchor `/audit-logs#export-format` to the new one.
Jules Huang: will add redirect in the PR and update the changelog entry: "Clarify export format (NDJSON), add pseudonymization example, fix broken export doc link."
Samir Patel: merged. Thanks everyone :shipit:
Maria Gomes (Legal): no objections.
